text: Entry Requirements 1. Candidate must be under 25 years old, with a high school diploma or equivalent at least. 2. You need to have the certificate of HSK4 Chinese Proficiency Test with a score of 180(inclusive) or above. 3. CSCA Test Subjects: Professional Chinese(Applicants for Chinese-taught programs are required to provide), Mathematics. For applying for science or engineering majors, one of Physics and Chemistry should be selected for examination. 4. The scores of each subject in the China Scholastic Competency Assessment(CSCA) are above 35 or the relative percentile ranking is within the top 60%. * If your Chinese proficiency does not meet the requirements, you may first receive the Chinese language training for 1-2 years.
